nom: Kopari Beauty Sunglaze Sheer Setting Mist Sunscreen SPF 50

segments.oily: One reviewer with acneic/oily skin reports level 3 breakouts within a week and warns oily-skinned users away from the product, while others describe the finish as non-greasy and lightweight.
segments.dry: One reviewer with dry skin reports the product made her skin tighter and worse, with no setting effect; another warns dry skin to stay away because of the alcohol smell, while a different reviewer says it adds moisture and hydration without heaviness.
segments.sensitive: Reports diverge sharply: several reviewers with sensitive skin describe severe burning, watering eyes and irritation, while others with self-described sensitive or scent-sensitive skin say it did not irritate them at all and even praise it for super sensitive skin.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 50s and 60s describe it as lightweight, not settling into fine lines, and giving a fresh glow without heaviness or grease.
segments.combination: One reviewer notes it works better applied before makeup and feels lightweight without greasiness, without specifying further skin issues.

concerns.aging: Reviewers who mention mature or sun-damaged skin report a lightweight, non-greasy finish that does not settle into fine lines and gives a fresh, glowy look; one long-term user in her 60s calls it a flawless finish for her age.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers describe added hydration and a dewy, glass-skin finish with no heavy or sticky feeling; one reviewer with dry skin instead reports it left her skin tight and worse.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports no sunburn or redness after outdoor use without other sun protection; no other redness-specific reports appear.
concerns.barrier: Not addressed by reviewers in terms of barrier repair or damage.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports it makes sun-damaged skin look tanned rather than sun-damaged; no other pigmentation-specific comments appear.
concerns.blemishes: Reports conflict: one reviewer with acneic/oily skin describes cystic-level breakouts and another suspects the fragrance caused breakouts, while a separate reviewer reports no breakouts or eye irritation at all.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers describe the finish as non-greasy, matte-glow, or lightweight; one reviewer nonetheless calls the formula 'very very oily' and says it never fully dries down, and another notes it stayed oily on skin even after showering.

aspects.libelle: Strong, lingering chemical or animal-like smell
Burning or stinging sensation near eyes
High price relative to product amount

extraits.texte: First of all im an esti👋🏻 very big on the idea of this being a sunscreen setting spray. It was recommended to me by the Ulta girl WHILE I was alreayd standing in line with my Charlotte Tilsberry setting spray. (holy grail btw and great for all skin types) she told me it was basically the same thing…. the biggest read flag to me was how many oil based ingredients that were in the product, (i have acneic/oily skin) but I took her word for it because she claimed it was even better than my charlotte tilsberry. Its only been a week and ive been having level 3 acneic breakouts…. oily skin humans do not buy this product. it also hurt my eyes and stinks. Would not recommend
Worst product ever. I'm dry and this thing made it so much worse. My skin is tight and gross. Didn't set my makeup. It smells so chemically. Might as well spray your face with paint thinner.

Bought during the 21 days of beauty so 1/2 off but this slightly burns for a moment or two after spraying on my face. I don't have acne so no open wounds. Also smells like straight alcohol. I won't be purchasing again and if you have dry skin....stay far away!

This is by far the absolute best setting spray/sunscrean I've tried, and I have tried many! The spray comes out in a smooth fine mist, no splatters or wet areas, dries quickly and leaves the prettiest dewy look on my skin. Not sparkley or flashy, just naturally glowing. My makeup wears all day long and it does not irritate my super sensitive skin. I'm ordering my second bottle now and a travel size for my purse. A must try!!!

This is an amazing product. It is easy to apply, has good coverage and makes my skin look glossy and smooth. It gives good sun protection but does need to be reapplied. I highly recommend it. I have sensitive skin and this did not irritate my skin at all.

extraits.titre: Obsessed! The Perfect SPF Mist for Mature Skin
extraits.texte: I'm 61, and finding a sunscreen that actually works with mature skin—without feeling heavy or settling into fine lines—has been a challenge. Sunglaze Sheer Setting Mist SPF 50 has honestly been a game changer for me. What I love most is how lightweight it feels. It goes on as a fine mist and doesn't disturb my makeup at all—in fact, it actually helps set it. My skin looks fresh and slightly glowy, not greasy or sticky. That's rare for a sunscreen, especially one with high SPF. I also appreciate how easy it is to reapply throughout the day. No rubbing, no mess—just a quick spray and I'm protected again. It's become a staple in my daily routine, whether I'm wearing makeup or not. At this stage in life, sun protection is non-negotiable, and this product makes it effortless and enjoyable. I genuinely love it and will absolutely keep repurchasing.

Bought this with low expectations but I have been so happy with this product it does exactly what it claims to do .. i highly recommend it and I am a 66 yr old girlie and this product gives my skin a perfect flawless finish and that's hard to do at my age Constance
